definitions.connected_load: native connected-load post-transition index; F may remain active; not satisfied QoS or necessarily free deployment
definitions.decision_reason: first differing lexicographic score versus R action at the actual S state
definitions.one_clock_error: qhat at first 30-second endpoint minus native QoS at that endpoint; dynamic users/P10 and coarse model differ
definitions.readiness: nominal deployment readiness is not assignment restoration or connected load; timestamps are retained separately, not treated as identical targets
definitions.release_error: initial chosen forecast minus observed release; later decisions can change charging competition
definitions.uncertainty: clock/start summaries are descriptive repeated observations, not independent-world confidence intervals
definitions.weights: exact zero at current nominal full-fleet radio snapshot, not zero actual service value

scope: complete saved S artifacts; no simulation, fit or counterfactual policy execution
